title: Choose the visual world for celebratemark.life
question: The roll assigned The Zone Chart. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Zone Chart
options.lineage: Tune-and-balance zone charts: the as-built drawings Mark delivered on every Sonipoint job
options.thesis: The day drawn as a plan: tinted zones, plain labels, one level number each, leader lines, nothing loud.
options.viewport: A drawn site plan of the shelter grounds with the Farmington River running through it. One dark inverted field carries Saturday, October 10, 11 AM, with two big buttons: Directions and Add to calendar. Below the fold, the plan draws itself section by section as you scroll.
options.risk: If the zones read as a literal floor plan, older visitors may hunt for a map key instead of the date; every label has to be a plain word.

raised.raise: Rank is inversion: only the date field prints dark on the pale sheet.
The day's schedule is ruled rows with fixed columns; nothing floats.
Every word sits on its own clear layer; text never lands on texture or fill edges.
One label grid rules every lodging entry: name, town and minutes, phone.
On the phone the active section floods its tint full-bleed behind its heading.
The date is the largest type on the page; the first viewport is not timid.

regions.label: Peoples State Forest picnic shelter, Barkhamsted CT

options.label: The Routed Park Sign
options.lineage: Connecticut DEEP routed wooden trail signs: brown board, cream letters, an arrow and a distance
options.thesis: The site is the trailhead kiosk you will walk past on the day.
options.viewport: A brown board with cream routed letters: Saturday, October 10, 11 AM, an arrow, and a distance, standing in front of a painted ridge of October pines.
options.risk: The most familiar answer for a forest memorial; a run in this category would plausibly land here on its own.

options.label: Multiplane Cel Dawn
options.lineage: multiplane cel animation: painted forest planes sliding at different speeds toward a lit cottage
options.thesis: A painted October morning on the river you sink through toward the lit shelter.
options.viewport: Five painted planes: far ridge, pines, birches, river, shelter with one lamp lit; the date on its own clear cel over the nearest plane.
options.case: Wins the audience axis: a forest morning with a lamp lit at the shelter is exactly the place. Loses clarity: parallax and rack focus under older eyes, and the date competes with a painting.
options.risk: Beautiful and slow to read; the painting can win and the facts can lose.

options.label: Split-flap Board
options.thesis: When and where as ruled rows on one board that everyone reads at once.
options.viewport: One board: SAT OCT 10 · 11:00 AM · PEOPLES STATE FOREST · EAST RIVER ROAD, then rows for directions, lodging, memories.
options.case: Holds the clarity axis completely: fixed columns carry the facts. Loses audience: the concourse clack belongs to travelers, not to a family in a forest.
options.risk: Reads as a train station; the cascade motion is noise to a grieving reader.

options.label: Depot Destination Blind
options.thesis: Stacked cloth courses stepping under one window.
options.viewport: One window showing one legend at a time.
options.case: Nobody at this gathering identifies with a bus blind, and one-legend-at-a-time hides the facts.
options.kept: Rank is inversion: one dark field only.

options.label: Sneaker Box Wall
options.lineage: stacked sneaker boxes with end labels
options.thesis: Every section a box you pull from a stack.
options.case: Wrong audience and wrong tone; the lid hinge hides content behind interaction.
options.kept: One label grid rules every entry.

options.label: Bebop Title Card
options.thesis: Hard cuts, colliding caps, flooded color fields.
options.case: Too loud for grief and hard for older readers; deliberate letter collisions fight legibility.
options.kept: One field floods behind the active title.

options.label: Futurist Bolted Book
options.case: Shouting is the opposite of what this family asked for; angled type fails older eyes.
options.kept: Type scale courage: the date is the biggest thing on the page.

canonCard.label: The memorial template
canonCard.thesis: What funeral-home sites ship, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Portrait, name, dates, a paragraph, an event card.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any obituary page, by design.
